segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi, this is Ben from Northstar Labs. I just need a copy of our July invoice and to make sure the PO number is on it before I send it to accounting.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I get the account name and either the invoice number or billing email?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Account is Northstar Labs, billing email is ap@northstarlabs.com. I think the invoice is INV-48219, for July 1 through July 31.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. Give me just a second in the billing tool. Okay, I have invoice INV-48219 here, total is $2,340 for 18 seats. What PO number should be listed?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: PO-7746. It may already be on the account, but the PDF I have doesn't show it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I see it was added after the invoice generated. I’m going to refresh the invoice PDF with PO-7746 included. One moment.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. I emailed the updated PDF to ap@northstarlabs.com and copied you at ben.harris@northstarlabs.com. You should see it in a minute or two.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, just came through. Looks good.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I also noted ticket 318742 with the invoice number and PO update, so if accounting asks, they can reference that.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s all I needed. Thanks, Maya.
